title: Indian-Origin Navanethem "Navi" Pillay Awarded Nobel Peace Prize 2026
summary_full: Pillay was born to Narrainsamy Naidoo and Santhama Naidoo in 1941 in a poor neighborhood of Durban in the Natal Province of South Africa. Her grandparents came from India as indentured servants to work on South African sugar plantations in the 1890s.
